caption: The drawing depicts a single, old bronze bell positioned upright in the center of the image. The bell has a flared bottom and a slightly tapering cylindrical body. The surface of the bell is rough and textured, displaying areas of discoloration typical of aged metal, with colors ranging from dark brown to grayish-green, suggesting oxidation or patina. Around the upper section of the bell, there is a raised horizontal band with an inscription and some decorative relief elements. Attached to the very top of the bell are two prominent metal loops, one larger and one smaller, likely used for hanging the bell. The background is beige and plain, with no other objects or features, providing contrast against the darker-colored bell. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature, "Abritton."
title: Church Bell
